from controller import Controller

class TestController(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_start_behavior(self):
        c = Controller()
        # Initial state
        self.assertEqual(c.generation, 0)
        self.assertFalse(c.busy)
        
        # First start
        g1 = c.start()
        self.assertEqual(g1, 1)
        self.assertTrue(c.busy)
        
        # Second start
        g2 = c.start()
        self.assertEqual(g2, 2)
        self.assertTrue(c.busy)
        
        # Rows and decisions should be preserved
        c.rows = [1, 2, 3]
        c.decisions = {"a": 1}
        c.start()
        self.assertEqual(c.rows, [1, 2, 3])
        self.assertEqual(c.decisions, {"a": 1})

    def test_poll_status(self):
        c = Controller()
        c.start() # g=1
        
        # Queued/Running should keep busy and return False
        self.assertFalse(c.poll_status(1, "queued"))
        self.assertTrue(c.busy)
        self.assertFalse(c.poll_status(1, "running"))
        self.assertTrue(c.busy)
        
        # Completed should return True ONCE
        self.assertTrue(c.poll_status(1, "completed"))
        self.assertFalse(c.poll_status(1, "completed")) # Second time False
        
        # Failed should end busy and return False
        c.start() # g=2
        self.assertTrue(c.busy)
        self.assertFalse(c.poll_status(2, "failed"))
        self.assertFalse(c.busy)
        
        # Stale status returns False
        self.assertFalse(c.poll_status(1, "completed"))

    def test_finish(self):
        c = Controller()
        c.start() # g=1
        c.poll_status(1, "completed")
        
        # Correct finish
        rows = [10, 20]
        self.assertTrue(c.finish(1, rows))
        self.assertEqual(c.rows, [10, 20])
        self.assertFalse(c.busy)
        
        # Duplicate finish
        self.assertFalse(c.finish(1, [30]))
        
        # Stale/unrequested finish
        self.assertFalse(c.finish(2, [40]))
        
        # New start
        c.start() # g=2
        c.poll_status(2, "completed")
        self.assertTrue(c.finish(2, [50]))
        self.assertEqual(c.rows, [50])

    def test_set_decision(self):
        c = Controller()
        c.start()
        c.set_decision("job1", 100)
        c.start() # Refresh
        self.assertEqual(c.decisions["job1"], 100)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
